verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration offers online digital services, including an eligibility-finder tool, online applications, eVisas, a processing-time checker and an ID Check app, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, chatbot, or any way to delegate tasks to one. The listed tools are standard guided web flows, not an agentic assistant.
